title: Unemployment Insurance Appeals: Exhibit Packet Preparation for Video Sessions
content:
Exhibit preparation days for a video session of Unemployment Insurance Appeals are allowed according to the number of exhibits the appellant has submitted on the appeal.

**Schedule.** The video exhibit preparation days are the two-exhibit preparation days when two or more exhibits submitted by the appellant stand received on the appeal, the one-exhibit preparation days when exactly one does, and zero days when none does. These days are added to the video block gap, and the set hearing date is moved later by the total before the calendar-day rule is applied.

| Exhibits submitted by the appellant and received on the appeal | Preparation days |
|---|---|
| two or more | 5 |
| exactly one | 3 |
| none | 0 |

## What counts

- Only exhibits the **appellant** submitted: on a claimant's appeal, the claimant's exhibits; on an employer's appeal, the employer's. Exhibits of the other party are not counted.
- Every exhibit recorded as received from the appellant counts, whether it met the exhibit deadline or was recorded as late.

*Hypothetical cases:* the claimant appellant submitted one exhibit and the employer three — 3 days; the employer appellant submitted two exhibits — 5 days; only the other party submitted exhibits — 0 days.
